item.description:

item.title: No Litter Bins!, 23rd October
item.description:
There are 2 x footbridges in Abbey Wood across the train track. This one pictured is at Bostall Manorway. They are constantly littered with refuse, nappies and graces (some = bagged dog waste). Could not side ls of these bridges be considered for pins? Clearly users are just dumping their waste on, under and around these bridges. Positive action needs to be taken to bring that waste to one focal point for easier collection … if nothing can be done to prevent such blighting of the landscape and bridges in the first place.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Bostall Manorway, Abbey Wood
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Littering Hotspot, 23rd October
item.description:

This behaviour blights our neighbourhood. Something practical needs to be done to prevent recurrence. If my suggestions are no good, then please come up with workable alternatives. Thank you
